# Reference review trigger

::: {.hub-idea-hero}
<p class="hub-idea-status">Idea · High priority · 2/9 readiness fields complete</p>

## What does this mean?

Flag generated reference answers that need more evidence or a human check before guiding a ranking.
:::

## Why does it matter?

A selective review trigger could reduce avoidable reference failures without reviewing every request.

## How does it work?

<ol class="hub-record-path">
<li class="hub-record-path-step">Measure signals that indicate a generated reference may be unreliable.</li>
<li class="hub-record-path-step">Route flagged references to grounding or human review.</li>
<li class="hub-record-path-step">Compare the trigger with always-review and never-review controls.</li>
</ol>

## What do we know?

The existing audits motivate selective escalation, but the local trigger and its
acceptance rule are not yet frozen. Completed E5 refinement evidence is recorded
as a study, not mislabeled as a future ready test.

## What is missing?

- Decision rule
- Dependencies
- Artifact plan

## What happens next?

Define the local trigger features and acceptance rule.
